observations.behavior: Adds documentation and tests for artifact dismissal and version grouping.
observations.code_quote: Uploading a file under a name the run already has does not add a second file. Every upload stays on the manifest as its own entry, and clients group entries by name into one file with a version history: the newest upload is what the app shows, and the earlier ones sit behind a version picker on the row. That is how an agent revises a deliverable — upload it again under the same name.
